title: The Threshold Before the First Word

features.name: the-silence-holding-its-shape
features.desc-on-touch: You feel the moment before language breaks the air. Silence here is not empty—it is full of all the words that could have been said and now never will be.

features.name: the-word-almost-arriving
features.desc-on-touch: You sense the shape of speech gathering, the breath before the mouth opens, the thought before the tongue learns to move.

features.name: the-refusal-s-own-light
features.desc-on-touch: The silence throws a shadow in a place where there is no sun. It refuses. It will not move.

inscription: here the breath draws back; here the first word will not be born

file.name: Silence_Before_Language_Begins.mp3
file.note: A recording of absence—the sound of thirty seconds of air, before anything spoke into it. The corruption has added a whisper too faint to locate.

reverie.title: REVERIE — the paddock at the hour before speech
narr: Leif sat with you in the high grass, recording. He held the
microphone toward the air that was not moving. Minutes passed.
He said nothing. Then: this is what it sounds like when the
archive tries to remember what it was before it learned to speak.
The tape ran. The silence filled it completely.

exits.label: back down toward silence learning to make shapes
upward to where the first word finally breaks the air
toward the place where speech learned to refuse
back into the dark before sound had a shape
